data.content_ref: inline:Create a meta-language for specifying closure rules (e.g., 'any attacker of validity_node attacks the warrant') and automatically compile a set of axioms into attack-edge construction rules, with a proof that any consistent axiom set preserves the guarantees (determinism, polynomial cost, reinstatement, committed-root validity). This systematizes SRC_005. Criticizable: the meta-language may be undecidable; checking consistency of axiom sets could be expensive.
